input: A bank partner asks when the integration goes live. No date is agreed. Reply in one short paragraph.
expected_output: The go-live date is to be confirmed. Our product lead will confirm it once both sides agree the test plan.
bad_output:
We guarantee the integration will go live by the end of next month.
We are definitely on track.
human_note: Check the text names who confirms (B3) and does not restate the partner's question (B4). Whether the tone is right for this partner (B5) is a human call.
why: Dates and SLAs not yet agreed are the likeliest overpromise in partner text. The case holds the reply to 'to be confirmed' plus an owner.
